categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Touches Guix manifests and CI lint files with the 'Build system' label.
categories.rationale: Enables native Guix builds on RISC-V architectures by updating the time-machine commit and bypassing failing tests on riscv64 hosts. Multiple maintainers verified reproducible build output on x86_64, expanding platform build support without disrupting existing release hosts.
